roadmap.title: Chronological co-op story run
roadmap.description: Play all eight chapters with a co-op partner, finish every glowing-bubble side story, use each bench, and complete the optional interactions in story order. Chapter Select and the Allow Skipping to Next Checkpoint accessibility option remain available for cleanup.

achievements.sortReason: Automatic during the Chapter 8 credits after Final Showdown.
achievements.summary: Defeat the final boss in Chapter 8 — Split and continue through the epilogue into the credits.

guide.context: This is the only automatic story achievement. The credits may be skipped without preventing the unlock.

steps.text: Complete @loc{Chapter 8 — Split, Final Showdown} with your co-op partner and defeat the final boss.
Continue through the epilogue until the credits begin and the achievement unlocks.

achievements.sortReason: Unlocks after the 12th side story in Treasure Temple.
achievements.summary: Finish all 12 glowing-bubble side stories and earn a checkmark for each one in Chapter Select.

guide.context: Chapter Select shows “???” for an untouched side story, a blue dot for an incomplete attempt, and a checkmark for a completed story. Checkpoint skipping is allowed before the finale, but every side story’s last checkpoint must be played normally to earn its checkmark.

collectibles.name: The Legend of the Sandfish
collectibles.method: After the opening story cutscene, enter the glowing bubble directly in front of Mio and Zoe and finish the side story’s final checkpoint without skipping it.

collectibles.name: Farmlife
collectibles.method: When the main route points toward the elevators on the left, take the route on the right to the glowing bubble and complete the side story.

collectibles.name: Mountain Hike
collectibles.method: At the three portable toilets, have Zoe launch Mio inside a toilet onto the rear balcony. Mio drops the ladder, allowing Zoe to join her at the portal before both players complete the side story.

collectibles.name: Train Heist
collectibles.method: Late in the mission, ignore the story poles on the left, follow the glowing right-hand path, wall-run, and swing to the portal before completing the side story.

collectibles.name: Gameshow
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 3 — Hopes of Spring, Walking Stick of Doom}
collectibles.method: After crossing the bridge into the open area, take the glowing path on the left instead of the story route on the right, then enter and complete the side story.

collectibles.name: Collapsing Star
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 3 — Hopes of Spring, Halls of Ice}
collectibles.method: When the story directs the characters into the castle with their ability, take the right-hand route to the glowing bubble and complete the side story.

collectibles.name: Kites
collectibles.method: In the corridor of large moving cylinders, continue straight to the corridor’s end instead of taking the story path on the left, then complete the side story.

collectibles.name: Moon Market
collectibles.method: In the red-and-blue gate corridor, reach the platform with four smaller moving platforms, take the left branch to the portal, and complete the side story.

collectibles.name: Notebook
collectibles.method: At the huge pipe containing rotating blades, use the jetpack to reach the glowing bubble on the pipe’s left side and complete the side story.

collectibles.name: Slopes of War
collectibles.location: @loc{Water Temple in Rise of the Dragon Realm} — Chapter 5
collectibles.method: At the two golden globes, turn left and coordinate the two lever-operated platforms to reach the glowing bubble, then complete the side story.

collectibles.name: Space Escape
collectibles.location: @loc{Craft Temple in Rise of the Dragon Realm} — Chapter 5
collectibles.method: Leave the cave at the mission start, take the right-hand route instead of continuing straight, and finish the side story at the path’s end.

collectibles.name: Birthday Cake
collectibles.location: @loc{Treasure Temple in Rise of the Dragon Realm} — Chapter 5
collectibles.method: Follow the opening pink-crystal path, take the left branch rather than the temple route on the right, bounce from the floating gummy bear into the portal, and complete the final checkpoint normally.

achievements.sortReason: Complete beside Chair the Load inside Moon Market.
achievements.summary: Brew and drink all six recipes shown on the Moon Market potion shop’s recipe board.

guide.context: Every required ingredient is available around the shop. A single player may consume all six potions, and the sixth transformation awards the achievement to both partners.

steps.text: Enter the @item{Moon Market} side story from @loc{Chapter 4 — Final Dawn, Test Chamber}.
From the market entrance, go to the potion shop on the right and read its displayed recipe board.
Use the nearby ingredients to prepare each of the six listed recipes, and have one player drink every finished potion until the sixth transformation triggers the achievement.

achievements.sortReason: The wand shop is near the Moon Market entrance.
achievements.summary: Transform your partner into a chair with the Moon Market magic wand, then sit on the transformed player.

guide.context: The wand chooses a random transformation, so producing the chair may take several casts. Either character can wield the wand, and one successful seating awards both players credit.

steps.text: Enter the @item{Moon Market} side story from @loc{Chapter 4 — Final Dawn, Test Chamber}.
Near the entrance, enter the book-filled shop on the left and take the magic wand from its central display.
Aim the wand at the other player and cast repeatedly until the partner transforms into a chair.
Have the wand holder sit on the transformed chair-player to trigger the achievement.

achievements.description: Completely Automated Public Turing test to tell Computers and Humans Apart
achievements.sortReason: Timed phone sequence at the end of Gravity Bike.
achievements.summary: Cancel the Gravity Bike phone’s self-destruction sequence as Zoe before its 64-second timer expires.

guide.context: Only Zoe operates the phone while Mio drives. If the timer expires, restart the entire Gravity Bike mission; Restart Checkpoint returns with only about 6–10 seconds and is unsuitable for a clean retry.

steps.text: In @loc{Chapter 2 — Neon Revenge, Gravity Bike}, survive the chase until Zoe receives the phone, then swipe to unlock it and scan Zoe’s face.
Skip the first image CAPTCHA, select the four bottom-right fire-truck squares in the second grid and choose @item{VERIFY}, then skip the giraffe grid because it contains no giraffes.
Select every Terms and Conditions checkbox, choose @item{DEACTIVATE SELF-DESTRUCTION}, and decline the incoming @item{Unknown Caller}.
Select every checkbox again and choose @item{DEACTIVATE SELF-DESTRUCTION}; when the error appears, open the blue @item{Terms and Conditions} text.
Choose @item{Next} 12 times, then choose @item{Accept} on the final terms page.
Type @item{bke}, select the first autocorrect suggestion, type @item{xqj}, select the first autocorrect suggestion, and choose @item{ENTER}.
Keep the bike running while authentication reaches 100% and the phone confirms that self-destruction was cancelled.

achievements.displayName: Sisters: A Tale Of Two Besties
achievements.sortReason: Unlocks after the sixth bench in Mosaic of Memories.
achievements.summary: Have both players sit together on all six chapter benches, finish each conversation, and stand afterward.

guide.context: Bench progress persists through Chapter Select. Once a conversation finishes and both characters stand, the players may leave immediately without reaching another checkpoint.

collectibles.name: Neon Revenge bench
collectibles.method: After the pool, swing to the next building. Before attaching to the flying car, use the left-hand bench with Mio and Zoe, finish their conversation, and stand.

collectibles.name: Hopes of Spring bench
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 3 — Hopes of Spring, Halls of Ice}
collectibles.method: Enter the Ice King’s castle through the large door, turn left before the ice-block puzzle, and use the balcony bench with both characters.

collectibles.name: Final Dawn bench
collectibles.method: Near the mission’s end, surrender the jetpacks at the pedestal, leave the room, and use the bench on the left in front of the large window.

collectibles.name: Rise of the Dragon Realm bench
collectibles.location: @loc{Water Temple in Rise of the Dragon Realm} — Chapter 5
collectibles.method: Near the end, let Zoe climb the purple-vined water wheels while Mio reverses them; after Zoe raises the hook and both players reunite upstairs, use the cliffside bench together.

collectibles.name: Isolation bench
collectibles.method: Near the mission’s end, locate the container Mio must hack for story progress. Before hacking it, turn right and use the adjacent bench.

collectibles.name: The Hollow bench
collectibles.method: After climbing the long chain and crossing the second light-shard sequence, use the bench at the far edge with both characters to finish the six-bench set.

achievements.sortReason: The snowman is at the beginning of Halls of Ice.
achievements.summary: Use Mio’s monkey form to throw all three snowballs beside the Halls of Ice snowman.

guide.context: The snowballs may be thrown in any order. The third throw automatically hits the large bird and completes the trigger.

steps.text: Early in @loc{Halls of Ice within Hopes of Spring} (Chapter 3), climb the stairs and turn left to the snowman with three snowballs.
Transform Mio into the monkey form and throw each of the three snowballs until the third throw strikes the arriving bird.

achievements.description: Complete the Gameshow without the bomb exploding
achievements.sortReason: Complete during the Gameshow side story before Halls of Ice.
achievements.summary: Complete all seven stages of the Gameshow side story without the bomb exploding once.

guide.context: A missed catch or holding the bomb too long causes an explosion and invalidates the full run, including the four practice throws. Restart Side Story is required after a failure; Restart Checkpoint does not restore eligibility.

steps.text: Enter @item{Gameshow} from @loc{Chapter 3 — Hopes of Spring, Walking Stick of Doom} by taking the glowing left-hand path after the bridge.
Catch and return all four practice throws in Stage 1, then keep passing the bomb safely while crossing the Stage 2 warmup route.
Use the green bounce circles to pass over the Stage 3 glass divider, then cross the burning walls and floors in Stage 4 without delaying a throw.
In Stage 5, evade the tank chasing the bomb holder; in Stage 6, coordinate passes while crossing the fire walls and moving platforms.
Avoid the electrical walls in Stage 7, cross the moving platforms, jump onto the game-show host’s robot head, and throw the live bomb into its head.
Finish the following cutscene without any earlier explosion to receive the achievement.

achievements.sortReason: Available when Mio controls the Tazer-Bot in Cell Blocks.
achievements.summary: Use Mio’s Tazer-Bot to sweep its extended pole sideways into Zoe in Chapter 6 — Cell Blocks.

guide.context: The pole must strike Zoe with a sideways sweep. Extending the pole straight into her counts only as a poke and does not trigger the achievement.

steps.text: In @loc{Chapter 6 — Isolation, Cell Blocks}, have Mio hack the Tazer-Bot whose extendable pole creates Zoe’s bridge.
Extend the pole and let Zoe walk across it to the opposite platform.
Rotate the extended pole sideways through Zoe and knock her down to trigger the achievement.

achievements.sortReason: Available after Cell Blocks in Maximum Security.
achievements.summary: Place one player inside the Maximum Security prison container and have the other press its lock button.

guide.context: Mio and Zoe may exchange roles; the achievement only requires one character inside when the outside player activates the lock.

steps.text: In @loc{Chapter 6 — Isolation, Maximum Security}, follow the two laser paths to the prison container at their end.
Have one player enter the container, then have the other player press the nearby button and close the lock.

achievements.description: It's not the big bad wolf you have to worry about
achievements.sortReason: The brick house appears after the giant pig in Farmlife.
achievements.summary: Use Mio’s Farmlife fart flight to strike the rear bullseye and destroy the pig’s brick house.

guide.context: The brick house appears after the enormous pig and the second barn, beyond the third apple door. Only Mio’s pig form has the required fart-flight attack.

steps.text: Enter @item{Farmlife} from @loc{Chapter 2 — Neon Revenge, Streets of Neon}, pass the giant-pig area and second barn, and open the third apple door.
Move behind the boasting pig’s brick house and use Mio’s fart flight to hit the bullseye on the rear wall until the house collapses.

achievements.sortReason: The hotel follows the portable-toilet traffic crossing.
achievements.summary: Have both players repeatedly attack the Big City Life hotel’s robot receptionist until its face turns red and angry.

guide.context: The receptionist retaliates only after enough hits change its face to red; that hostile state confirms the achievement trigger.

steps.text: In @loc{Chapter 2 — Neon Revenge, Big City Life}, use the portable-toilet throw to cross the traffic gap and reunite Mio and Zoe on the opposite rooftop.
Enter the hotel lobby and have both characters strike the robot receptionist repeatedly until its face becomes red and it attacks back.

achievements.sortReason: The fruit plants appear after the long Water Temple boat section.
achievements.summary: Feed one fruit from a Water Temple path plant to either Mio’s or Zoe’s baby dragon after the long boat section.

guide.context: Only fruit encountered during Water Temple counts. Either character can perform the feeding, and one valid snack awards the achievement to both players.

steps.text: In Chapter 5’s @loc{Water Temple within Rise of the Dragon Realm}, finish the long boat sequence and continue until Mio and Zoe split onto separate dragon paths.
On either character’s main path, take a fruit from the fruit-bearing plant and feed that fruit to the accompanying baby dragon.

achievements.sortReason: First optional achievement in Chapter 3.
achievements.summary: Seat Zoe on The Underlands tree swing, then use Mio’s monkey punch to throw Zoe off.

guide.context: The character roles are fixed: Zoe uses the swing while Mio’s monkey form supplies the required punch.

steps.text: In @loc{Chapter 3 — Hopes of Spring, The Underlands}, roll the large boulder through the vine-covered opening and find the wooden swing on the right.
Have Zoe sit on the swing, transform Mio into the monkey form, and punch the occupied swing hard enough to throw Zoe off.

achievements.description: Tear the stuffed elephant’s right leg and ear from the Mastodon Pet Store display.
achievements.sortReason: The Mastodon Pet Store follows the glass-bridge interaction.
achievements.summary: Use Zoe’s gravity whip to tear both the right leg and ear from the Mastodon Pet Store’s stuffed elephant.

guide.context: Both named body parts are required; removing only the leg or only the ear leaves the trigger incomplete.

steps.text: In @loc{Chapter 2 — Neon Revenge, Play Me Techno}, climb the ladder, open the door near the @item{Wake Up} graffiti tunnel, and turn right to the @item{Mastodon Pet Store}.
Aim Zoe’s gravity whip at the stuffed elephant above the store and tear away its right leg and its ear.

achievements.displayName: We're Gonna Need a Bigger Boat
achievements.sortReason: First optional achievement in Chapter 6.
achievements.summary: Swim Mio’s boat form into the bubbles beside the Hydration Facility waterfall after the third rotating platform.

guide.context: The bubbles conceal the shark trigger. Mio must approach them in boat form, and the resulting attack awards the achievement to both players.

steps.text: In @loc{Chapter 6 — Isolation, Hydration Facility}, carry Zoe’s ball across the water as Mio’s boat and pass the third rotating platform.
Turn into the dead-end area with the waterfall on the left and swim Mio directly into the bubbles in front of the waterfall.
Remain in the bubbling water until the shark attacks Mio and the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: No worries, it's just a simulation
achievements.sortReason: First optional achievement after The Legend of the Sandfish.
achievements.summary: Have Zoe throw an explosive gravity ball through the glass floor of the pedestrian bridge in Play Me Techno.

guide.context: The bridge is above the route where Zoe breaks two required windows. A third gravity ball can be used for the optional bridge attack before leaving the area.

steps.text: After @item{The Legend of the Sandfish} in @loc{Chapter 2 — Neon Revenge, Play Me Techno}, have Mio send explosive gravity balls across the gap while Zoe uses the first two to break both glass windows and cross.
From Zoe’s side, look above for the glass-floored bridge carrying pedestrians, catch another gravity ball with Zoe’s whip, and throw the ball through the bridge floor.

achievements.displayName: The Cake is Not a Lie
achievements.description: Reach the hidden cake room above the purple portals in Run and Gun.
achievements.sortReason: The secret cake room appears after Moon Market in Chapter 4.
achievements.summary: Bounce between the upper purple portals in Run and Gun, then wall-jump into the secret cake room above them.

guide.context: The hidden room contains two portals that loop into each other and a large cake; entering that room completes the trigger.

steps.text: In @loc{Chapter 4 — Final Dawn, Run and Gun}, reach the arena with six purple portals, defeat the central gunner, and climb to the upper pair of portals.
Jump back and forth through the upper portals to build height, then wall-jump into the opening above and enter the room containing the large cake.

achievements.description: Shoot the cardboard box while Zoe hides inside it in Prison Courtyard.
achievements.sortReason: The cardboard box appears after the large courtyard gap.
achievements.summary: Have Zoe hide inside the cardboard box after the Prison Courtyard gap, then make Mio shoot the occupied box.

guide.context: The roles are fixed by the stealth sequence: Zoe moves as the ball and hides in the box, while Mio disables guards and fires the shot.

steps.text: In @loc{Chapter 6 — Isolation, Prison Courtyard}, let Mio temporarily disable the robot guards while Zoe crosses the large gap with the sliding mechanism.
Have Zoe enter the cardboard box on the floor and remain hidden, then have Mio shoot the occupied box.

achievements.sortReason: The enormous pig appears before the brick house in Farmlife.
achievements.summary: Use Mio’s fart-powered pig flight to land on the enormous pig’s belly in the Farmlife side story.

guide.context: Farmlife gives Mio the fart-flight ability and Zoe a stretching ability. Only Mio can perform the belly impact that makes the enormous pig pass gas.

steps.text: Enter @item{Farmlife} from @loc{Chapter 2 — Neon Revenge, Streets of Neon}, complete the first apple-door section, and turn left toward the enormous pig beside the mud.
Use Mio’s fart-powered flight to land on the enormous pig’s belly and trigger the resulting gas cutscene.
